answer: The quorum is drawn by lottery after the epoch closes, so a farm cannot know which graders will judge it and cannot bribe them in advance. 4 graders each stake 42 POA on the verdict, and a lone honest grader can force an appeal that slashes the rest of the panel. The beacon is the check that cannot be faked, the garden is the price the attacker pays, and the karst is the record that outlives the epoch.
